description: Shaking Table Tests of Reinforced Concrete Intermediate Short Column Frame is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Yu-Che Ling, National Taiwan University. The data from the four RC column frame shaking table tests presented here is based on previous experimental work by Prof. Shyh-Jiann Hwang of National Taiwan University. These tests were conducted by Reui-Shiang Su at the National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering (NCREE) in Taiwan in 2007. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Reinforced concrete, Columns, Shear failure, Shaking table tests, dynamic collapse, near fault ground motion. Published 2025-07-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
